rows.question: Examine: Does the handed SSP Addendum record the current DoD lockout parameter for AC-7 from Table D-1 / DSPAV? Cite the official addendum cell. Do not guess the value. Official file was not fetchable from cyber.mil on 2026-09-08.
Interview: Who applies the DoD AC-7 lockout parameter, and is it written in the SSP Addendum rather than silently edited into the FedRAMP SSP?
Examine: Does the handed package show US-person / citizenship screening for privileged users as required by the current CSP SRG / SSP Addendum? Cite the official row. CMMC is not a substitute.
Examine: Does the handed package show CAC/PIV (or approved PKI) for privileged DoD users at Credential Strength D, with the implementation cited from the package (not inferred)?
Examine: When crypto is in scope, does the handed package cite active FIPS 140-3 CMVP module certificates (not historical, not revoked) for the modules actually used?
Test: Does the handed evidence show FIPS mode enabled on in-scope modules, not merely licensed?
Examine: If the CSO will connect to DoD networks, does the handed package show BCAP/SCCA-ready managed access points (AC-17(3)) rather than a High-only commercial edge?
Examine: If the path is IL5 NSS, does the handed package show the AO-selected CNSSI 1253 Table D-1 '+' rows from the official instruction (cnss.gov), not a blog count?
